M4 guide
The M4 is the rifle to fall back on when nothing else feels right. At 811rpm with forgiving recoil, a quick 2.6-second reload and fast aim speed, it does everything well and has no real weak range. It dominated launch week and only slipped to A tier as the Hyeon Burst, VEL 46 and Cronen Osprey rose around it. It hasn't got worse.
Both patches since launch have helped it. The 28 October update extended its range, and Season 1 stretched its max damage range again and raised its headshot multiplier. That keeps its kill time consistent across the 20 to 30 metre fights that decide most 6v6 objective games. It is slower than the top SMGs up close and slower than the Hyeon Burst when bursts land, but it punishes small mistakes less than either.
Its Hurricane Apex converts it to a high-velocity 5.7x28 close-quarters setup at max level, and Season 1 gave that build more range too, so the gun gets a second life once you've finished its camos.
How to use the M4
Build for recoil and range; it already handles well.
Use it as your first class while you level everything else.
On SMG-heavy maps, try the Hurricane Apex instead of switching guns.
